steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the fresh pipeline; verify single entry-point LLM node
Step 2 — Click the entry-point node; verify Trigger defaults to "Chat Message"
Step 3 — Open the Trigger dropdown; verify exactly 2 options in order (Schedule removed, EL-7011)
Step 4 — Select "Webhook"; verify auto-save, settings modal opens, Apply persists
Step 5 — Save is a no-op (disabled); reload; verify Trigger still shows 'Webhook'
Step 6 — Switch back to "Chat Message" from a genuinely different current value (persisted Webhook)
Step 7 — Add a Code node, make it the entry point; verify the same Trigger + 2 options render there
